This [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''commander''' was in charge of the ''[[Starship Musica]]'' during its voyage to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. A [[Unidentified female Imperial saboteur|female arrival]], however, proceeded to seduce him. When [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] witnessed this, they became suspicious of her actions to the commander, and tried to get the commander to report to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] what had occurred, although the commander dismissed them, citing that the pair, being [[Droid/Legends|Droids]], simply did not know what occurs between a man and a woman.<ref name="story treatment">{{WebCite|url=http://www.starwarsholidayspecial.com/text/story_treatment.htm|text=Story Treatment, 05/31/78|work=[[Starwarsholidayspecial.com|The Star Wars Holiday Special]]|archivedate=20130121081554}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Rebel commander was a planned character in the early story treatment for ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''.<ref name="story treatment" />
